title: St. John's Co-Cathedral
visualBrief: Individual medium-fi current exterior:two limestone towers/open belfries/green bells,pale pyramids/base balustrades,exposed upper-right bell frame,three clock fields,column-supported central balcony/single recessed door/upper arch,niches/cornices/gable,pale metal nave roof,repeated sloping buttress ribs and lower side/rear masses. Exact sculpture/dial text/full interiors,adjacent buildings and the background dome excluded.

sourceFacts.horizontalBasis: Retained exact-QID way23352829/current parent and two tower parts. The broad northern lower mass contains a smaller reconstructed upper belfry. Signed twin-tower facade retained without overall rescaling.
sourceFacts.architecturalHeights: The approximately66x44m current parent and two front building-part plans control horizontal placement. The north part includes a broad lower mass;its upper tower is a photo-led9.5x9.3m reconstruction within that control. The south tower retains its raw plan. No part heights exist. The current17m parent is a generic levels-derived value and is not used as the overall cathedral height. Photo-led estimates are14.5..15.1m low aisles,22.5..27m nave,24m central front/27m gable,27.5..36.7m belfries,37.6m parapets,45.3m pale pyramid tips and46.2m finials. Right upper bell frame reaches44.2m. Openings,balcony,clocks,buttresses and all vertical stages remain approximate;no independently measured heights.

Individual medium-fi exterior from two inspected useful pictures and standard PMTiles/DEM. Bell profiles,roof balustrades,clock/calendar fields,balcony/niches,gable relief and side/rear details are selected approximations. North upper belfry plan is inferred within the larger mapped base. Exact inscriptions/sculpture,full interiors,adjacent museum/city blocks,background dome and certified walking excluded. Physical phone/laptop timings pending.

Skyline preserves twin pale pyramid towers,upper-right exposed bell frame,central balcony/door/upper arch,gable,nave roof and coarse buttress rhythm. District adds shared graphs,recessed closed portal/upper glass,selected columns/rails,three clock fields and flat belfry/bell marks. Street opens actual belfries with suspended green bells and recesses blind niches;closeup refines arches,bells,rails and clock ticks. Detail changes remain visible.
importReason: Four browser levels retain St. Johns individual pyramid-tower/three-clock/balcony facade and repeated nave buttresses at its signed Valletta location.
